name: Halima Ogawa-Twumasi
role: Counter-surveillance and mole detection — counterintelligence specialist
location: The Underbelly — sub-street tunnels and maintenance corridors
description:
Halima Ogawa-Twumasi is slight and easy to overlook, which is exactly the point. At 37, he has the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. He works as a counterintelligence specialist out of The Underbelly, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Halima Ogawa-Twumasi is one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
core_desires: Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
psychology.secret: Halima Ogawa-Twumasi killed someone who didn't deserve it on a job three years ago and has never told anyone. The face appears in dreams weekly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "Everyone in this room is lying. My job is knowing who's lying about what."
"Paranoia isn't a disorder in this profession. It's a job requirement."
"I find the leak. What happens to the leak after that isn't my department."

story_hooks: Someone is impersonating Halima Ogawa-Twumasi on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A Tier 4 executive offers Halima Ogawa-Twumasi a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
The fixer who handles Halima Ogawa-Twumasi's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
narrative_function: Halima Ogawa-Twumasi is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.
augmentations: Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms. Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
